title: MP Materials Corp outlines 2025 magnetic materials plan at Baird 2026 conference
digest:
MP Materials Corp announced its progress and future magnetic materials business strategy at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference. CEO James Litinsky stated the company completed its initial transformation phase after going public in 2020 and aims to enter the magnetic materials sector by 2025.

The plan follows the company's acquisition of magnetic materials maker AMR in 2021, which expanded its portfolio beyond lithium batteries. The 2025 target aligns with its previously disclosed five-year roadmap for diversifying into critical minerals and advanced materials.

No financial details or specific product launches were provided during the presentation. The conference was held in virtual format as per standard industry practice for investor events.
